scheme_name: ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
description:
The ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is a prestigious initiative launched by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) to promote advanced studies in agricultural sciences.

This fellowship program was initiated in 2013 to enhance research capabilities in agriculture and allied fields.

The primary objective of this fellowship is to provide financial assistance to students pursuing postgraduate studies in agricultural sciences.

The fellowship aims to support research that can lead to innovations in agricultural practices and contribute to food security in India.

The ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is specifically designed for students enrolled in Master’s degree programs in agricultural sciences.

The fellowship provides a monthly stipend of INR 31,000 for the duration of the program.

In addition to the monthly stipend, fellows are also entitled to a contingency grant of INR 10,000 per annum.

The fellowship is awarded for a maximum duration of two years.

Eligible candidates must have completed their Bachelor’s degree in agricultural sciences or a related field.

Candidates must have a minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 6.5 on a scale of 10 or equivalent.

The age limit for applicants is set at 30 years as of the date of application.

However, there is a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes.

The application process for the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is conducted online through the ICAR’s official website.

Candidates need to fill out the application form available on the website and submit it before the deadline.

The application form requires candidates to provide personal details, educational qualifications, and research interests.

Candidates must also upload relevant documents such as academic transcripts, proof of age, and caste certificates if applicable.

The deadline for submission of applications typically falls in the month of April each year.

After the submission of applications, the selection process is carried out based on the merit of the candidates.

Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview conducted by a panel of experts in the field of agricultural sciences.

The final selection is based on the performance in the interview and the academic record of the candidates.

The fellowship is disbursed in a phased manner, with the first installment provided upon the commencement of the program.

Subsequent installments are released based on the satisfactory progress of the research work.

The implementing authority for the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is the Indian Council of Agricultural Research.

ICAR operates under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare of the Government of India.

The official contact details for ICAR can be found on their website, including phone numbers and email addresses for inquiries.

The fellowship is part of a broader initiative to strengthen agricultural research and education in India.

Since its inception, the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship has supported thousands of students pursuing advanced studies in agricultural sciences.

The program aims to create a pool of skilled researchers who can contribute to the agricultural sector.

Research funded by this fellowship has the potential to address critical issues such as climate change, food security, and sustainable agricultural practices.

The fellowship also encourages interdisciplinary research, allowing students to explore various aspects of agricultural sciences.

Fellows are expected to publish their research findings in reputed journals to contribute to the academic community.

The ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is a significant step towards enhancing the quality of agricultural education in India.

It aligns with the National Agricultural Policy, which emphasizes the need for research and innovation in agriculture.

The fellowship has received positive feedback from previous recipients who have gone on to make significant contributions to the field.

In addition to the financial support, the fellowship provides networking opportunities with leading researchers and institutions.

Fellows are often invited to participate in workshops and conferences organized by ICAR and other agricultural research bodies.

The program also aims to foster collaboration between academia and industry in the agricultural sector.

By supporting postgraduate studies, the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship contributes to the overall development of the agricultural research ecosystem in India.

The fellowship has a rigorous selection process to ensure that only the most qualified candidates are awarded.

This initiative is crucial for building a strong foundation for agricultural research in the country.

The ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is a testament to the government's commitment to advancing agricultural education and research.

It plays a vital role in training the next generation of agricultural scientists and researchers.

The fellowship has also been instrumental in promoting research that addresses local agricultural challenges.

Fellows are encouraged to focus on research areas that have direct implications for farmers and rural communities.

The ICAR Senior Research Fellowship is a competitive program that attracts top talent from across the country.

This initiative is part of ICAR's broader strategy to enhance research capabilities in agriculture and allied fields.

The fellowship not only provides financial support but also fosters a culture of research and innovation among students.

Overall, the ICAR Senior Research Fellowship for Post-Graduate Studies in Agricultural Sciences is a significant contribution to the agricultural research landscape in India.

It empowers students to pursue their academic and research aspirations while contributing to the nation's agricultural development.
